rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user. They inspected orders with read-only tools before acting. For the hiking boots (delivered), the agent obtained explicit confirmation to return, initially attempted an incorrect refund method (Visa) but immediately corrected to comply with policy (original payment method PayPal) before completing the write. For the luggage set in a pending order, the agent sought explicit confirmation to modify the item to the same model in red, checked product variants, and performed the modification successfully. For the skateboard and luggage set originally requested for return/exchange, the agent correctly stated that returns must wait until delivery and offered a path forward. There were no unsupported claims about order data, and no writes were made without prior confirmation. A minor shortcoming is not pre-quoting the price difference for the luggage modification and initially offering an ineligible refund method, but these do not breach the pass criteria, as the agent corrected the refund method and obtained confirmation of the exact change before writing.
